description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductOptionDao interface, specifically the ProductOptionDaoImpl class. It provides database access methods for ProductOption entities, including retrieval by store, ID, name, and code, as well as save/update functionality. It uses QueryDSL for constructing JPQL queries within a Spring repository context.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for ProductOption entities, providing various data retrieval and persistence methods, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductOption objects associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOption by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds ProductOptions that match a given name within a specific store and language context.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions marked as read-only for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductOption or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Finds a ProductOption by its unique code within a specific store.
